alt: 陶藝師坐在精緻陶碗旁，耐心端詳來訪者展示的工作室模型，思考合適的工作機會。
scene_prompt: A skilled adult ceramic artist sits calmly beside a display of finely made bowls in a bright studio. Two prospective workshop employers offer different opportunities using only wordless visual materials: one carries a small rough broken stool, another offers a well-equipped pottery studio shown as a plain miniature room model. The artist thoughtfully considers the suitable studio opportunity, hands resting patiently, beautiful completed ceramics establish her ability. No money bargaining, no text or symbols.
